question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Transleate**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word if corrected results in the formation of 'translate'.
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the correctly formed words:
 
• Translate: to change something written or spoken from one language to another.
 
 
• Example: *This article has been translated from Spanish into English.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the only** incorrectly** spelt word is: *Transleate*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The words, ‘transcend, transmit and transpire' are correctly spelt.
 
• Let us take a look at the meaning of correctly spelt words:
 
• Transcend: to go further than the usual limits of something.
 
• Transmit: to send or pass something from one person or place to another.
 
• Transpire: to become known; to be shown to be true; to happen.
